note: Thresholds are not set here; they stay in the engine (90, Gate 2 92). Gate 4 keeps its own semantic contract.

GATE_1.meaning: Gate 1 decides whether the planning set (strategy brief, pre-mortem, PRD, validation plan, technical architecture) is specific, consistent and testable enough to begin design alternatives and the roadmap; it does not judge implementation or product acceptance.

criteria.name: Problem and Users
criteria.question: Does the strategy brief state the problem with evidence, the intended users and measurable success metrics?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); STRATEGY_BRIEF

criteria.name: Requirement Testability
criteria.question: Are the PRD's functional requirements numbered, bounded, prioritised and each given an acceptance criterion a tester can check?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); PRD

criteria.name: Risk Coverage
criteria.question: Does the pre-mortem name the likely failure modes and does each have a control or an owner question?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); PRE_MORTEM

criteria.name: Validation Readiness
criteria.question: Does the validation plan map hypotheses and requirements to tests with thresholds and decision rules?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); VALIDATION_PLAN

criteria.name: Architecture Fit
criteria.question: Does the technical architecture meet the PRD's requirements and constraints, with open choices named rather than hidden?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE

criteria.name: Cross-Document Consistency
criteria.question: Do the five documents agree on scope, terms, priorities and open questions?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); joins all five inputs

GATE_2.meaning: Gate 2 decides whether the chosen design, interface specification, roadmap and implementation plan are coherent and executable enough to be broken into epics and slices.

criteria.name: Design Choice Rationale
criteria.question: Are real alternatives compared and is the chosen design justified against the requirements?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); DESIGN_ALTERNATIVES

criteria.name: Interface Specification
criteria.question: Can the interface be built from the UI/UX specification without guessing states, inputs or errors?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); UI_UX_SPEC

criteria.name: Roadmap Sequencing
criteria.question: Is the roadmap ordered by dependencies with exit criteria per milestone?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); ROADMAP

criteria.name: Implementation Executability
criteria.question: Does the implementation plan give work breakdown, dependencies, acceptance criteria and rollback a team can execute?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN

criteria.name: Cross-Document Consistency
criteria.question: Do design, interface, roadmap and plan agree with each other and with the PRD and architecture?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); joins all four inputs

GATE_3.meaning: Gate 3 decides whether the epics and slice index break the planned work into independent, testable slices that can be handed to agents as directives and tasks.

criteria.name: Epic Coverage
criteria.question: Do the epics cover every P0 requirement and planned milestone, with nothing silently dropped?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); EPICS

criteria.name: Slice Independence
criteria.question: Can each slice be built and verified on its own, with its dependencies stated?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); SLICE_INDEX

criteria.name: Slice Acceptance
criteria.question: Does each slice carry an observable acceptance check?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); SLICE_INDEX

criteria.name: Traceability
criteria.question: Does each slice trace to an epic and each epic to requirements?
criteria.source: src/registry.rs product_inputs and src/qroc.rs document_template (gate review contract); joins EPICS and SLICE_INDEX

GATE_5.meaning: Gate 5 (Brand & GTM Coherence Review) decides whether BRAND_GUIDE, GO_TO_MARKET meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Brand-Product Alignment
criteria.question: Does the brand voice match the product's actual capabilities and target audience?

criteria.name: GTM Channel Justification
criteria.question: Is each channel justified by where the target audience spends attention?

criteria.name: Messaging-Positioning Consistency
criteria.question: Do GTM messages use the Brand Guide's voice and values?

criteria.name: Execution Feasibility
criteria.question: Are proposed strategies executable with realistic team size and budget?

criteria.name: Measurability
criteria.question: Does every strategy have defined KPIs and measurement methods?

GATE_6.meaning: Gate 6 (Investment Readiness Review) decides whether FINANCIAL_OVERVIEW, FINANCIAL_SENSITIVITY, SLIDE_DECK meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Financial Projection Credibility
criteria.question: Do revenue projections decompose from customers x price x frequency?

criteria.name: Sensitivity Analysis Rigor
criteria.question: Does the tornado analysis cover all key Financial Overview assumptions?

criteria.name: Slide Deck Narrative
criteria.question: Does the deck follow a coherent story arc from problem to ask?

criteria.name: Cross-Domain Consistency
criteria.question: Do financials match the Business Plan revenue model?

criteria.name: Completeness for Purpose
criteria.question: Is the package sufficient for its stated purpose?

GATE_7.meaning: Gate 7 (Acquisition Strategy Review) decides whether MESSAGING_FRAMEWORK, OUTBOUND_STRATEGY, INBOUND_STRATEGY meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Message Clarity
criteria.question: Is the one-liner under 15 words, jargon-free, and specific to this product?

criteria.name: Audience-Message Fit
criteria.question: Are messages tailored per persona or segment from the Business domain?

criteria.name: Channel-Audience Match
criteria.question: Are proposed outbound and inbound channels justified by where the target audience actually spends attention?

criteria.name: Outbound-Inbound Coordination
criteria.question: Do outbound and inbound strategies complement each other rather than duplicate?

criteria.name: Measurability & Baselines
criteria.question: Are KPIs defined per channel with targets?

GATE_8.meaning: Gate 8 (Creative Execution Review) decides whether WEBSITE_SOCIAL, ADS_STRATEGY, VISUAL_ASSETS meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Brand Consistency
criteria.question: Do website, social, and ad specs use the Brand Guide's color palette, typography, voice, and visual style?

criteria.name: Platform Specificity
criteria.question: Are website pages specified at the level a developer can build from?

criteria.name: Visual Asset Completeness
criteria.question: Are all required assets specified: logo package, color system, typography, icons, and templates?

criteria.name: Deliverability
criteria.question: Can a designer or developer execute from these specs without guessing?

GATE_9.meaning: Gate 9 (Regulatory Foundation Review) decides whether COMPLIANCE_PRIVACY, PR_POLICY, LICENSING meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Regulatory Coverage
criteria.question: Are all applicable regulations identified from data handling, geography, and sector?

criteria.name: Data Flow Compliance
criteria.question: Does the privacy policy accurately describe actual data practices?

criteria.name: Licensing Accuracy
criteria.question: Are all dependency licenses identified and compatibility verified?

criteria.name: Risk Stratification
criteria.question: Are legal risks categorized P0/P1/P2 with likelihood and impact?

GATE_10.meaning: Gate 10 (Operational Legal Review) decides whether TERMS, CONTRACTS, REGISTRY_PREP meet the review's criteria before the domain continues.

criteria.name: Terms Enforceability
criteria.question: Are Terms structured with clear definitions, acceptance mechanisms, limitation of liability, and dispute resolution?

criteria.name: Contract Completeness
criteria.question: Are templates provided for the most common relationships?

criteria.name: Entity/Registration Readiness
criteria.question: Is entity selection justified for the funding strategy?

criteria.name: Cross-Domain Consistency
criteria.question: Do Terms match the product's actual capabilities from Product?
